defense_news.title: US Navy destroyers tested in Middle East as demands mount
defense_news.summary: The concentration of Navy destroyers in the Middle East raises questions about meeting sustained operational demand.

defense_news.title: Royal Navy successfully launches US Mk 48 torpedo from uncrewed submersible
defense_news.summary: Last week, the Royal Navy successfully launched a U.S.-made Mk 48 Heavyweight Torpedo from a British Excalibur uncrewed underwater vehicle.

defense_news.title: Italian Navy plots race of two local machines: an F-35B against a Ferrari
defense_news.summary: The Italian Navy wants to find out if one of its F-35B fighter jets can outrace a Ferrari SF90 on the ground.

defense_news.title: CENTCOM has become a battle lab for unmanned systems
defense_news.summary: Unmanned systems have moved quickly from experimentation and exercises into the demands of an active war.

geo_news.title: "Yapay zeka, adli bilirkişilikte karar destek aracı olmalı" değerlendirmesi
